paleography.indonesian_translation: Semoga tiada rintangan. Inilah tata cara pengobatan anak-anak, patut diketahui oleh yang mengabdi pada dharma budi tatwa. Adapun jika anak baru lahir, jangan lalai mengamati tanda-tanda pada tubuh anak, serta tangan dan kakinya, bagian tengah matanya. Jika bagian putih matanya tampak biru, telapak kaki/tangannya dingin, tangisnya serak, serta sayu mengantuk, dingin seperti itu, sakitnya dinamakan blahan. Obatnya, sarana: sembung, beras merah, gamongan, tempelkan pada ubun-ubunnya (blahan). Serta untuk bedak/balur tangan dan kakinya, sarana: buah sirih (buah base), nekuning, wangkongsari, jabuggarum, pesgadubhang, balurkanlah. Jangan sampai memandikan anak tersebut. Serta untuk bagian dadanya (harapnya), sarana: humbin tuntung, bawang dadas. Dan jika bagian putih matanya membiru, uratnya tampak kemerahan darah, dan rautnya layu pucat, serta sayu...
paleography.english_translation: Om, may there be no obstacles. This is the procedure of child medicine (usadha rare), to be known by those dedicated to dharma budhi tattwa. When an infant is born, do not neglect to examine the signs of the infant, the hands and feet, and the center of the eyes. If the whites of the eyes are bluish, hands and feet cold, the crying raspy, drowsy, cold in such a way, the illness is called blahan. Its remedy, ingredients: sembung, red rice, gamongan; plaster it onto the fontanelle (blahan). And to powder/coat the hands and feet, ingredients: betel nut/fruit (buah base), nekuning, wangkongsari, jabuggarum, pesgadubhang; apply as a body powder. Do not bathe this child. And for the chest/front, ingredients: humbin tuntung, crushed onion (bawang dadas). And if the whites of the eyes are blue, veins visibly red with blood, face pale/limp, and drooping...
